title: Driver Risk Standard: Recent Fraud and Route Clawbacks in Instant Cashout Amounts
content:
## Standard

The largest instant cashout of a **Driver Earnings and Wayfare Pro** earnings account is worked out on a risk-treated balance. The risk method is applied to the settled balance, which is the available balance after any credits still settling today are taken off, and it follows the debits posted to the account within the last 3 whole months:

1. when a trip was disqualified for fraud in that period (a debit taking back the trip's pay with the reason fraudulent trip), the settled balance is multiplied by 0.8;
2. when no trip was disqualified for fraud but a route-inefficiency clawback was posted in that period, the most recent route-inefficiency clawback is taken off the settled balance;
3. when neither was posted, the settled balance is used as it stands.

The risk method acts on the settled balance before any further amount, the cashout fee included, is taken off.

## Criteria table

| Debits in the last 3 whole months | Treatment of the settled balance |
|---|---|
| At least one fraud disqualification (with or without route-inefficiency clawbacks) | Multiplied by 0.8 |
| No fraud disqualification; at least one route-inefficiency clawback | Less the most recent route-inefficiency clawback |
| Neither | Unchanged |

A fraud disqualification takes priority: when both kinds of debit appear in the period, the settled balance is multiplied by 0.8 and no clawback is taken off.

## Hypothetical cases (settled balance 500.00)

| Debits in the last 3 whole months | Risk-treated balance |
|---|---|
| One fraud disqualification | 400.00 (500.00 multiplied by 0.8) |
| Route-inefficiency clawbacks of 12.00 and, most recently, 7.50 | 492.50 (500.00 less 7.50) |
| A fraud disqualification and a route-inefficiency clawback of 7.50 | 400.00 |
| None | 500.00 |
